purpose: Define the acceptance contract for the future mecha_engine.lifecycle package module before moving lifecycle code out of labs/lifecycle_sim.

external_references.title: Tamagotchi Connection manual index
external_references.used_for: Care-loop categories such as feeding, sleep, attention, health, and age.

external_references.title: JaxLife: An Open-Ended Agentic Simulator
external_references.used_for: Artificial-life framing where survival and behavior are simulator outputs.

external_references.title: A Contextual-Bandit Approach to Personalized News Article Recommendation
external_references.used_for: Sequential action selection from context and observed feedback, kept out of lifecycle promotion until reward shaping beats baseline.

required_public_surface.name: initial_state
required_public_surface.signature: initial_state(grid: dict, slip_profile: dict | None = None) -> dict
required_public_surface.contract: Build a bounded lifecycle state from a valid grid and optional SLIP profile without mutating inputs.

required_public_surface.name: advance_tick
required_public_surface.contract: Apply one supported lifecycle action to a live state, clamp continuous variables, update history, and return a new state.

required_public_surface.name: run_episode
required_public_surface.signature: run_episode(grid: dict, slip_profile: dict | None = None, policy=None, actions=None, ticks=72, rng_seed=None) -> dict
required_public_surface.contract: Run a deterministic bounded episode from a valid grid using either a named policy or explicit actions.

required_public_surface.name: reward_for_transition
required_public_surface.signature: reward_for_transition(previous_state: dict, next_state: dict, action: str) -> float
required_public_surface.contract: Return a deterministic bounded transition reward without writing learner memory.

initial_state_acceptance: Reject grids that fail the supplied SLIP profile.
Initialize every continuous state variable inside 0..1.
Derive state from real grid stress, damage, and body mass.
Derive behavior priors from SLIP neediness, sleepiness, curiosity, and survival weights when supplied.
Do not mutate the input grid or SLIP profile.
transition_acceptance: Return a new state without mutating the prior state.
Increment age_ticks by exactly 1 for live states.
Clamp hunger, energy, stress, bond, and grid_stability into 0..1.
Set explicit terminal death causes for starvation, energy collapse, stress collapse, and grid collapse.
episode_acceptance: Support a named policy or an explicit action stream.
Reject simultaneous ambiguous policy and action-stream requests.
Stop applying actions after terminal death.
Report ticks_requested, survival_ticks, alive, death_cause, need_balance, recovery_events, action_counts, final_state, and history.
Score need_balance across the full requested horizon.
Fill missing post-death ticks with 0.0 for the horizon score.
Preserve deterministic results for the same grid, profile, policy/actions, tick horizon, and RNG seed.
Reproduce the Stage 0 policy comparator metrics before package promotion or record an intentional metric revision in a new decision record.
reward_acceptance: Reward full-state balance rather than a single action preference.
Include hunger recovery, energy recovery, stress reduction, and bond improvement signals.
Remain deterministic for the same transition.
negative_checks: package tests mutate sys.path to reach labs
death happens without an explicit death cause
early death raises average need-balance by shortening the horizon
online reward shaping is promoted as package behavior
feedback learners are mixed into the lifecycle module
future_verification_commands: python -c "from mecha_engine.lifecycle import initial_state, advance_tick, run_episode, reward_for_transition"
next_research_step: Use this gate as the lifecycle acceptance checklist when the user explicitly starts package scaffold or lifecycle package work.
